description: Aim quality separate from awareness (design doc §14.2; M4 spec claim 6): an error cone in milli-degrees that starts wide, converges linearly over settle_ticks while the target stays visible, resets when sight breaks, and carries a swing-through penalty for swing_ticks after a target appears. penalty_per_mdeg turns the cone into a hit_chance penalty (basis points of a percent per milli-degree).
